who.text: God, Job, Eliphaz, Bildad, Zophar, Elihu and the accuser.

where.text: The land of Uz and the heavenly court.

when.text: Dating of the events and composition is disputed; the book may be set in an ancient patriarchal era.

what.text: Job, a righteous man, suffers deeply and debates God's justice with friends, and God answers from the whirlwind. Genre: Wisdom poetry with prose frame.

before.text: Stands among wisdom literature with no clear historical anchor.

stakes.text: Explores innocent suffering, divine justice and honest faith.

immediate_summary.text: Job, a righteous man, suffers deeply and debates God's justice with friends, and God answers from the whirlwind. Genre: Wisdom poetry with prose frame.
